title: Settings
intro: Change the markets this brand is tracked in, how buyers should understand it, the attributes answers are scored on, and the language of this app. Save applies every change together.
missingBrand: Select a brand in the sidebar before you change settings. If this is your first visit, finish setup first.
unavailable: Settings could not be loaded because this server does not have the settings API yet. Deploy the API update, apply migration 006_brand_ui_language.sql, then try again.
fixTitle: Settings were not saved. Fix the items below, then save again.
saved: Settings saved. The markets, brand profile, attributes, and app language are updated.
savedSwitch: Settings saved. This page is switching to {language}.
saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Check your connection, then try again.
marketsBody: Daily answers are collected for each country and language pair. Add at least one. You can track up to 5. The same country and language cannot be listed twice.
locationsRequired: Add at least one country and language.
locationLimit: You already have 5 locations. Remove one before you add another.
locationDuplicate: {country} in {language} is listed twice. Remove one.
profileBody: This is how the brand is described when prompts and attributes are written. A description, a category, at least one product, and at least one audience are required.
descriptionRequired: Write a description of 1 to 500 characters.
categoryRequired: Write a category of 1 to 80 characters.
listHint: Type a short phrase and press Enter. {count} of {max}.
listRequiredHint: Add at least one. Type a short phrase and press Enter. {count} of {max}.
listRequired: Add at least one entry to {field}.
listFull: This list already has {max} entries. Remove one before you add another.
phraseEmpty: Type a short phrase, then press Add.
phraseDuplicate: {item} is already in this list. Type a different phrase.
attributesBody: These are the qualities brand perception scores. Keep at least one. Rename an attribute, add one, or remove one you no longer want scored.
attributeRequired: Enter a name for every attribute.
keepOne: Keep at least one attribute. Add a name before you save.
uiBody: This is the language of the app. It is separate from the market language above. The app switches after you save.
uiRequired: Choose the app language: English, French, Spanish, Italian, or German.
